title: Western Göktürks
capsule: The Western Turkic Khaganate ruled from the Altai to the Aral–Caspian region after the late-6th-century split of the Türk empire, controlling the Silk Road oasis cities of Sogdiana and allying with the Byzantine Empire against Sasanian Persia. Weakened by the rivalry of its Onoq (Ten Arrows) tribes and by Tang campaigns, it was conquered by Tang China in 657–659, which then administered the Western Türk lands through protectorates.
